targetCatalogue.name: Alpha Crater Rim
targetCatalogue.scientificDescription: Prominent highland ridge with basaltic outcrops.

tasks.title: Enter the Terrain Rover
tasks.description: Locate the vehicle near the SOL 03 starting point and enter through the ladder.

tasks.title: Review Previous Mission Records
tasks.description: Access Mission OS to review persisted SOL 01 and SOL 02 reconnaissance, resource baselines, and soil investigation logs.

tasks.title: Inspect Water and Nutrition Supplies
tasks.description: Verify current life support reserves (SOL 03 reference water: 40%). Save inspection confirmation.

tasks.title: Inspect Environment and Oxygen Systems
tasks.description: Inspect external daytime Martian telemetry and cabin atmospheric life support. Save inspection record.

tasks.title: Inspect Mission Equipment & Tools
tasks.description: Verify the EVA high-resolution imaging and geological equipment inventory.

tasks.title: Drive to Highland Photography Checkpoint
tasks.description: Follow the navigation beam to Sol3_Checkpoint atop the highland overlook.

tasks.title: Capture Mountain Range Photographs
tasks.description: Exit the rover in EVA suit and capture between 4 and 6 high-resolution mountain photographs with the EVA camera.

tasks.title: Return to the Terrain Rover
tasks.description: Return to the vehicle with the captured photographic dataset and re-enter via ladder.

tasks.title: Review Mountain Photographs in Mission OS
tasks.description: Open Mission OS and review the photographic gallery and spatial telemetry captured at the overlook.

tasks.title: Submit Mountain Research Log
tasks.description: Complete and save the field geological research log documenting mountain features and observations.

tasks.title: Drive to Final Expedition Destination
tasks.description: Navigate following the active beam to SOL3_Finishing_Point.

tasks.title: Final Mission Control Overview & Report
tasks.description: Open Mission OS, review the complete consolidated 3-Sol mission history, and save the final expedition report.

tasks.title: Final Water and Nutrition Confirmation
tasks.description: Perform the final life support resource assessment and save the confirmation record.

tasks.title: Final Environmental Telemetry Confirmation
tasks.description: Perform final environmental sensor checks and confirm surface telemetry.

tasks.title: Final Equipment Inventory Audit
tasks.description: Verify and lock the equipment inventory locker.

tasks.title: Complete Journey
tasks.description: Authorize final expedition sign-off in Mission OS and play the final expedition cinematic.
